description: Ledger rows and claims taken out of conformance/manifest.json because the requirement they assessed was removed from the standard or parked outside it. They are kept for the record and claim no status: nothing here is assessed, claimed or checked by conformance/check.mjs or conformance/qualify.mjs. Each entry gives the date, the reason, lastWorkingCommit, the last commit on main before the rulings of 12 November 2026, at which what the entry assessed worked and after which nothing changed it before its removal, and the row or claim as it last stood, without its status.

row.summary: Under the rule, every UPDATE and RETIRE after a committed TRANSFER carries an instruction commitment unless a control authority made it; a verifier or index that selects the rule refuses one without, as instruction-commitment-absent on linkage, and the same bytes pass with the rule off; the report's limits say the evidence is custody-dependent.
row.applicability: when a deployment declares instructionCommitment required
row.notes: The reference index selects the rule with INSTRUCTION_COMMITMENT=required and declares it as instructionCommitment in its custody profile entry; the hosted index and the reference application do not yet select it, and the application records no instructions, so the hosted declaration stays not-selected until they do.

row.summary: A version 3 state is one output: the BRC-162 token prefix, then the version 2 layout of key, OP_CHECKSIG, seventeen minimal pushes, eight OP_2DROP and one OP_DROP; a bare seventeen-field body is version 2, one behind a prefix is version 3, and either version string in the other place is no DPP output.

row.summary: The prefix is BRC-162: a deploy is OP_0 OP_1 OP_2DROP and sits at output 0 with an empty token id; a value output is the 32-byte token id in internal byte order, OP_1 and OP_2DROP; the amount is one unit as the minimal script number; neither carries a payload.

rows.reason: Parked on 12 November 2026 with record version 3, the token carrier (spec/token-carrier.md as it stood); the specification, fixtures, vectors, proposed baseline and example are under docs/reference/parked/token-carrier/.

row.summary: The body is the seventeen-field version 2 layout under the version string 3; both preimages are VarInt-framed and opened by the version 3 domain tags (dpp-record-v3/actor-signature, dpp-record-v3/publisher-signature); keys derive under [1, 'dpp token v3'] with actor_keyID and passport_id as key identifiers, counterparty anyone; a signature made under the version 2 protocol verifies under nothing in version 3.

row.summary: The token id is the deploy txid with the implied output index 0, written <txid>_0; every state after the genesis carries it in internal byte order and it equals the lineage genesis; a token id naming another deploy, or written in display order, is another token and the link is refused as token-id-mismatch.

row.summary: The carrier invariants over the version 2 invariants: the genesis is a deploy at output 0 with an empty token id; every later state is a value output carrying the lineage token id; one carrier output per transaction; no version crosses into or out of a carried lineage; ISSUE at genesis only, no state after RETIRE and control proven, as in version 2.

row.summary: A tip spent by a transaction with no carrier output is a burn: a token reader records the token as burnt, a passport reader finds no state in that transaction and reports the lineage as ended without a RETIRE and the tip as spent; RETIRE remains the only orderly end.
